title: aira capillaris var. cupaniana
intro: Aira capillaris var. cupaniana, commonly known as Wood Meadow-grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae). The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Aira capillaris var. cupaniana include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
